title: 第20章 诡异第21章 探路
content_zh:
第20章诡异
不用虎镇嵩交代，杜成金就已经打起了十二分的小心，目光不时的观察着周围，不敢有丝毫懈怠，他比在场的其他人都更惜命。只是这里看起来跟前面似乎一模一样，根本就看不出任何异常。
大家又往前走了几步，忽然就听前面的虎镇华道：“大哥，找到了，溪松仙师和那两个帮众的尸体就在前面。”
大家顺着他指点的方向，就见前面大约十丈的位置，地上正躺着一具尸体，看穿着打扮，与外面那几位仙师极其相似，应该就是虎镇嵩所说的那个溪松仙师。再往前，模模糊糊的能够看到另外两具尸体，除了猛虎帮的那两名帮众还能有谁？
虎镇衡似乎是个急性子，不等大哥吩咐，就朝着那几具尸体急纵而去，似乎想要一探究竟。后面的皮应熊也要纵身往前，只是被旁边的松鹤悄悄地拉住了，他顿时惊觉，连忙止住了脚步。
溪松仙师就是死在这里，周围到底有什么危险还不清楚，怎么能乱闯呢？虎镇嵩眼见虎镇衡如此鲁莽，连忙叫道：“四弟，小心。”
虎镇衡往前跨出了好几步，听到大哥的喊声，这才想起他之前的交代，连忙止住了自己的身形。可他的反应终究是晚了一些，不等他转身，忽然凭空出现一把巨斧，就朝着他的后背就劈了过去。
这一幕顿时就惊呆了在场所有人，哪怕是虎镇嵩，也是暗暗心惊。在这之前，大家已经做好了心理准备，这里就算是有危险，应该也是来自于暗中布置的机关消息，又或者是在什么地方隐藏着怪物，虽然令人害怕，但总也有迹可循，大家总能找到破解的办法。
哪知道这里的危险竟然如此诡异，这完全就是不按套路出牌，竟然会凭空的出现一把巨斧，之前没有任何征兆，这还怎么防备？想到这些，大家的心情不由得又紧张了几分。
再说那虎镇衡，身手也是了得，感觉到背后生风，他第一时间就做出了应对。往前是不敢的，往后也不可能，他腰部一拧，硬生生的施展了一个移形换位的身法，侧移四五尺，躲开了那把巨斧。
那巨斧劈空之后并没有继续追击，很快就消失不见了，但是事情却并没有那么简单，虎镇衡一只脚刚刚落地，地下竟然忽然冒出了一条手指粗细的黑色藤条。虎镇衡只注意着空中，根本就没有想到地上会突然出现这种变化，再加上他躲避巨斧时力道已经用尽，一只脚顿时就被那藤条给缠了个正着。
藤条只有三尺多长，上面长满了半寸长的尖刺，散发着蓝幽幽的光泽，上面很有可能带着某种不知名的毒素。藤条缠到虎镇衡脚上之后，就开始快速的收缩，尖刺随之刺进了虎镇衡的腿中。
眼看着虎镇衡要遭殃，距离他最近的虎镇华终于的找到了出手的机会，右手甩出一把飞刀，斩在了那黑色的藤条之上。那藤条被飞刀砍中，顿时化为点点光芒消散在了四周。与此同时，虎镇嵩甩出一道长鞭，卷在虎镇衡的身上，把四弟给拉了回来。
虎镇衡虽然被救了回来，可他双腿发黑，下半身已经不能动弹，显然是已经中了那黑色藤条的毒，算是丧失了战斗力。谁也不知道这虎镇衡中的是什么毒，可又不能眼睁睁的看着他毒发身亡，大家只好找了一些治疗蛇毒的药内服外敷，算是死马当做活马医。
也不知是那藤条的毒素不重，还是蛇药起了效果，服药之后，毒素没有继续往上蔓延，只是双腿的症状并没有减轻多少。
这才刚刚开始，就损失了一个帮手，虎镇嵩的脸黑如锅底。其他人的情况也好不到哪去，这密地之中危险重重，现在是虎镇衡，下一个说不定就是自己了。这地方太诡异了，那凭空出现的巨斧，还有那突然出现的藤条，根本就没有任何征兆，也就不知道该如何防备。
可一直停在这里不是办法，虎镇嵩很快打破了沉寂，道：“我们时间有限，还是要有人在前面探路，大家都说说有什么办法。”
虎镇嵩的话说完，却没人接腔，大家都是普通人，又不是神仙，能有什么办法？这时，他身后的虎镇泰忽然道：“我看这事简单，那三个小孩留着也没什么用处，不如挑一个在前面探路。”
一听这话，皮应熊顿时就怒了，道：“虎镇泰，你什么意思？你们猛虎帮怎么不派人？凭什么让我们探路？”
寂空大师也道：“是啊，他们几个小孩实力低微，遇到危险也躲避不开，你这不是让他们送死嘛？”

眼见西平府一众江湖人士对虎镇泰群起而攻，猛虎帮那边也有人站了出来，虎镇华往二哥身边一战，道：“我们猛虎帮已经伤了一个兄弟，就算是轮也该轮到你们了吧？”
这才走了几步？现场的气氛就又紧张起来了，虎镇嵩也是头大，最后只好大声道：“大家都不要争了，既然都不愿意派人，那就让皮应熊派一只驯兽过去，这下大家总该满意了吧？”
每一只驯兽都是自己费了无数心血才训练出来的，是自己的私有财产，怎么能够轻易损失，皮应熊道：“凭什么……”
不等皮应熊把话说完，虎镇泰就威胁道：“我们猛虎帮已经伤了一人，这次必须你们派人，你若是不愿意，那就让你女儿过去。”
相对于人的性命来说，驯兽的性命也就不值一提了，不光是猛虎帮的人，西平府的其他人也赞成这个意见，不同意也不行，不让驯兽去，难道自己亲自去探路不成？皮应熊扭头看了一圈，见大家似乎都是这个意思，最终只能无奈的答应了下来。
皮应熊吹了一声口哨，一直吊在后面豹和猴子迅速的跟了上来，随后他的口中发出一连串的音节，那豹就朝着前面继续走去，剩下那只猴子，则拽着皮应熊的衣服爬到了他的肩头。
那豹似乎颇通人性，往前走的速度很慢，仿佛也在观察着周围的情况，起初两三丈的距离还没有什么，又往前走了几步，地上突然就冒出了一道土刺，朝着豹的腹部刺去。
新书期，希望大家多多投票支持！
（本章完）

Chapter 20 Weird
Without Hu Zhensong's explanation, Du Chengjin had already been extremely cautious, observing his surroundings from time to time, not daring to slack off at all. He cherished his life more than anyone else present. It's just that this place looks exactly the same as before, and there is nothing unusual at all.
Everyone took a few more steps forward, and suddenly heard Hu Zhenhua in front say: "Brother, we found it. The bodies of Immortal Master Xisong and the two gang members are in front."
Everyone followed the direction he pointed and saw a corpse lying on the ground about ten feet in front. Judging from the clothes, it looked very similar to the immortal masters outside. It should be the Xisong Immortal Master Hu Zhensong mentioned. Further forward, two other corpses can be vaguely seen. Who else can be there besides the two members of the Tiger Gang?
Hu Zhenheng seemed to be impatient. Without waiting for his elder brother's instructions, he rushed towards the corpses as if he wanted to find out. Pi Yingxiong behind him also wanted to jump forward, but was quietly held back by Song He next to him. He was suddenly startled and stopped quickly.
Immortal Master Xisong died here. It was unclear what dangers there were around him, so how could he break in? Seeing Hu Zhenheng being so reckless, Hu Zhensong quickly shouted: "Fourth brother, be careful."
Hu Zhenheng took several steps forward. When he heard his elder brother's shout, he remembered his previous explanation and quickly stopped himself. But his reaction was a little late after all. Before he could turn around, a giant ax suddenly appeared out of thin air and struck him in the back.
This scene immediately shocked everyone present, even Hu Zhensong was secretly shocked. Before this, everyone has been mentally prepared. Even if there is danger here, it should come from secretly arranged agency messages, or there may be monsters hidden somewhere. Although it is scary, there are always traces to follow, and everyone can always find a way to crack it.
Who would have thought that the danger here would be so weird? This is completely out of step with the rules. A giant ax will appear out of thin air without any warning before. How can we be prepared for this? Thinking of this, everyone couldn't help but feel a little nervous.
Besides, Hu Zhenheng was also very skilled. When he felt the wind coming from behind, he responded immediately. He didn't dare to go forward, and it was impossible to go back. With a twist of his waist, he forcefully performed a transformation technique, moving four or five feet to the side, avoiding the giant axe.
The giant ax did not continue to pursue after it struck the air, and quickly disappeared. However, things were not that simple. Hu Zhenheng had just landed one foot on the ground when a black vine as thick as a finger suddenly appeared from the ground. Hu Zhenheng only paid attention to the air and did not expect such a sudden change on the ground. In addition, he had exhausted his strength when avoiding the giant axe, and one of his feet was immediately entangled in the vine.
The rattan was only over three feet long, and was covered with half-inch-long spikes. It exuded a faint blue luster, and was likely to contain some unknown toxin. After the rattan wrapped around Hu Zhenheng's feet, it began to shrink rapidly, and the spikes pierced into Hu Zhenheng's legs.
Seeing that Hu Zhenheng was about to suffer disaster, Hu Zhenhua, who was closest to him, finally found an opportunity to take action. He swung a flying knife with his right hand and chopped it on the black rattan. The vine was struck by the flying knife, and it immediately turned into dots of light and dissipated around it. At the same time, Hu Zhensong whipped out a long whip and wrapped it around Hu Zhenheng's body, pulling his fourth brother back.
Although Hu Zhenheng was rescued, his legs were black and his lower body could no longer move. He had obviously been poisoned by the black rattan and had lost his fighting ability. No one knew what kind of poison Hu Zhenheng was poisoned, but they couldn't just watch him die from the poison, so everyone had to find some medicine to treat snake venom and apply it internally and externally, which was like treating a dead horse as a living horse.
I don’t know if it’s the vineThe toxin in the strip was not heavy, but the snake medicine had an effect. After taking the medicine, the toxin did not continue to spread upwards, but the symptoms in the legs did not alleviate much.
This was just the beginning, but he lost a helper, and Hu Zhensong's face was as dark as the bottom of a pot. The situation of others is not much better. There are many dangers in this secret place. Now it is Hu Zhenheng, and he may be the next one. This place is so weird. The giant ax that appeared out of thin air and the vine that suddenly appeared showed no signs at all, so I didn’t know how to prepare for it.
But staying here is not an option. Hu Zhensong quickly broke the silence and said: "We have limited time, so we still need someone to explore the way ahead. Let's talk about what we can do."
After Hu Zhensong finished speaking, no one answered. We are all ordinary people and not gods. What can we do? At this time, Hu Zhentai behind him suddenly said: "I think this is a simple matter. There is no use in keeping those three children. It is better to pick one to explore the way ahead."
Upon hearing this, Pi Yingxiong immediately became angry and said: "Hu Zhentai, what do you mean? Why don't your Tiger Gang send people? Why do you let us explore the road?"
Master Jikong also said: "Yes, these children are of low strength and cannot avoid danger. Aren't you asking them to die?"
Seeing the gangsters in Xiping Prefecture attacking Hu Zhentai, and some people from the Tiger Gang standing up, Hu Zhenhua went to his second brother and said, "Our Tiger Gang has injured a brother, even if it's your turn, it's your turn, right?"
How many steps have you taken? The atmosphere at the scene became tense again. Hu Zhensong was also confused, so he finally had to say loudly: "Let's stop fighting. Since no one is willing to send anyone, let Pi Yingxiong send a tame beast over. Now everyone should be satisfied, right?"
Every tamed animal has been trained by him with countless efforts. It is his own private property. How can he lose it so easily? Pi Yingxiong said: "Why..."
Before Pi Yingxiong could finish his words, Hu Zhentai threatened: "Our Tiger Gang has injured one person. You must send someone this time. If you are not willing, then let your daughter go."
Compared with human lives, the lives of tame animals are not worth mentioning. Not only the members of the Tiger Gang, but also other people in Xiping Mansion also agree with this opinion. It doesn't matter if they disagree. If they don't let the tame animals go, can't they go and explore the way themselves? Pi Yingxiong turned around and looked around. Seeing that everyone seemed to have the same intention, he finally had no choice but to agree.
Piyingxiong whistled, and the leopard and monkey who had been hanging behind quickly followed. Then he uttered a series of syllables in his mouth, and the leopard continued to walk forward. The remaining monkey grabbed Piyingxiong's clothes and climbed onto his shoulders.
The leopard seemed to be quite humane. It walked forward very slowly, as if it was also observing the surrounding situation. At first, there was nothing two or three feet away. After taking a few steps forward, a thorn suddenly appeared on the ground and stabbed towards the leopard's abdomen.
